# Flickerz Nest

> Flickerz Nest is a browser-based movie and TV discovery application at https://flickerz.dpdns.org. Visitors can browse a curated selection of titles, explore the wider catalogue in the app, and use an account to manage a personal watchlist and viewing progress.

## Main public pages
- [Home](https://flickerz.dpdns.org/): Flickerz Nest home.
- [Movies](https://flickerz.dpdns.org/movies): Curated movie directory with individual title pages.
- [TV shows](https://flickerz.dpdns.org/tv-shows): Curated series directory with individual title pages.
- [Genres](https://flickerz.dpdns.org/genres): How to browse using the app's genre filters.
- [Guides](https://flickerz.dpdns.org/guides): Manually maintained usage guides.
- [Watchlist guide](https://flickerz.dpdns.org/guides/how-to-build-a-watchlist): Advice for organising a personal list.

## Product and attribution
- Movie and TV metadata and images are sourced from The Movie Database (TMDB).
- This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
- Account, watchlist, playback and TV-mode features are part of the existing web application. Playback availability can vary by title and connected provider.
- The public SEO catalogue is intentionally curated; it is not a complete mirror of the TMDB database.
- Contact: wanidawar03@gmail.com

The canonical production domain is https://flickerz.dpdns.org.
